annotations.title: Preview or pay what campaign creators are owed

description: Default (no confirm): a PREVIEW, nothing charged: each payable creator gets the full amount, plus the Hermoso fee (3%, min $2 per creator), Stripe's payout costs at cost and one payment processing line (the same whatever pays; bank debit gets a discount), totals by card and by bank debit. confirm:true with acceptTerms:true creates one payment link: card (held 7 days) or method "bank" (pre-authorized debit, Canadian business bank account, held 14 days once it clears), then Stripe pays each creator. A disputed payment freezes every campaign and payout on the account. recordOnly with participantId: mark a creator paid outside Hermoso (moves no money). fromFunds:true pays from money already paid into the campaign (creator_campaign_funds): a preview, then confirm:true; nothing is charged. A creator who owes back a claw-back is paid the net. adjustUsd with participantId and cause: a one-off bonus (positive: payable at once from the budget, paid by the next payout) or deduction (negative: out of their unpaid earnings here, never from their bank); a preview, then confirm:true.

acceptTerms.description: REQUIRED true with confirm: the user accepts the creator-campaign terms for this payment (it pays creators on their instruction, is non-refundable once paid out, and they bear any dispute); recorded with the time

adjustUsd.description: a bonus (e.g. 25) or deduction (e.g. -10) for participantId

cause.description: adjustUsd: why; the creator sees it

confirm.description: true = create the payout and its payment link, after the user agreed to the previewed total

expectTotalCents.description: with confirm: the previewed total the user agreed to; a moved total charges nothing

fromFunds.description: pay from the campaign's funds instead of a new payment

participantId.description: with recordOnly: the creator paid outside Hermoso

participantIds.description: only these creators; default everyone payable
